name: Wolves in the Greenreach
description: Green wolves are on the west trail. Sylven wants eight of them down before the snare is named.

name: Puck the Snare
description: Puck the Snare takes travelers on the west trail and stays down longer than a wolf. Sylven wants the snare ended.

name: Mossantler
description: Mossantler is the stag the Greenreach rarely shows. Elder Vaela wants word that it has been met, and ended.

name: Wolves on the Hills
description: Hill wolves have come up to the south road of Ironhollow. Oswin wants eight of them.

name: Rusk the Hollow
description: Rusk the Hollow takes a toll in the hills and stays down. Oswin wants the toll ended.

name: Old Marrow
description: Old Marrow is the rare of the deep hills. Lord Edric, who keeps this castle for King Aldric Valdor, wants it met.

name: Wolves in the Valley
description: Valley wolves are on the young ground south of Grokthul Hold. Grukka wants eight of them.

name: Brug the Toll
description: Brug the Toll is not of this clan. He takes coin on the valley road. Grukka wants him ended.

name: Ash Drakes
description: Ash drakes are on the Grokthul Peaks, the ones the broken cold woke. Skaal wants eight of them. These are not Vargan's ogres.

name: Cindermaw
description: Cindermaw is the rare drake on the north of the peaks. Skaal wants it ended. The fang, if it drops, is yours besides the watch's pay.
